title: What's New in Manufacturing: Streamline Product Design (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Version comparison and subassembly display options
Editing versions and bulk item selection

features.name: Production BOM document attachment
features.description: Ability to add document attachments to production bills of material for storing additional information such as drawings, specifications, or materials needed.

features.name: Production BOM active version
features.description: Access to active versions of the production bill of material through the assist edit button, with version comparison matrix showing all information about the main BOM and available versions.

features.name: Subassembly display options in BOM
features.description: Option to adjust different option levels to determine how subassemblies are displayed, whether as entire subassemblies or their individual components.

features.name: BOM version list view with date and status
features.description: Version list page that displays the starting date and status of each BOM version for easier management and navigation.

features.name: Select items action for bulk BOM editing
features.description: Action to select multiple items at once when editing a production bill of material version, with the ability to update quantities for all selected items.

features.name: Edit in Excel functionality for BOM
features.description: Functionality to edit large bills of materials using Excel, providing an efficient way to manage large BOM lists.

features.name: BOM version certification confirmation dialog
features.description: Confirmation dialog that appears when closing a production BOM version page if the status is not certified, requiring certification before closing.

features.name: BOM navigation from item card
features.description: Ability to navigate to production bill of materials from the item card through actions related to assembly, with options to open the main BOM or jump directly to the certified version based on the current date.
